title: Detailed Christmas tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='treeGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2e8b57'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1a6b3c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Star on top -->
  <polygon points='50,4 53,12 62,12 55,17 58,25 50,20 42,25 45,17 38,12 47,12' fill='#ffd700' stroke='#ffec80' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Tree layers -->
  <!-- Top tier -->
  <polygon points='50,14 35,36 65,36' fill='#2e8b57' stroke='#3cb371' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Middle tier -->
  <polygon points='50,26 28,52 72,52' fill='#25804f' stroke='#3cb371' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Bottom tier -->
  <polygon points='50,38 20,68 80,68' fill='#1e7040' stroke='#3cb371' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Tier highlight edges -->
  <polyline points='35,36 45,32 55,32 65,36' fill='none' stroke='#4dd48a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polyline points='28,52 40,48 60,48 72,52' fill='none' stroke='#4dd48a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Tree trunk -->
  <rect x='45' y='68' width='10' height='12' rx='1' fill='#8b5e3c' stroke='#a0703c' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Trunk base/pot -->
  <rect x='40' y='79' width='20' height='6' rx='2' fill='#c0392b' stroke='#e74c3c' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Garland - swirl dots -->
  <path d='M38,40 Q44,36 50,40 Q56,44 62,40' fill='none' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='2,3'/>
  <path d='M30,56 Q40,50 50,56 Q60,62 70,56' fill='none' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='2,3'/>
  <path d='M24,72 Q37,64 50,72 Q63,80 76,72' fill='none' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='2,3'/>
  
  <!-- Ornaments - red baubles -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='28' r='3' fill='#e74c3c' stroke='#ff7878' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#e74c3c' stroke='#ff7878' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='46' r='3' fill='#e74c3c' stroke='#ff7878' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#e74c3c' stroke='#ff7878' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#e74c3c' stroke='#ff7878' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Ornaments - blue baubles -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#3498db' stroke='#85c1e9' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='58' r='3' fill='#3498db' stroke='#85c1e9' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#3498db' stroke='#85c1e9' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='64' r='2.5' fill='#3498db' stroke='#85c1e9' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Ornaments - gold baubles -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#f1c40f' stroke='#f9e654' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='72' r='3' fill='#f1c40f' stroke='#f9e654' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='74' r='2.5' fill='#f1c40f' stroke='#f9e654' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#f1c40f' stroke='#f9e654' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Small purple ornaments -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='2' fill='#9b59b6' stroke='#c39bd3' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='2' fill='#9b59b6' stroke='#c39bd3' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='66' r='2' fill='#9b59b6' stroke='#c39bd3' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Tinsel/light dots along tree edges -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='32' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='50' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='60' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='62' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  
  <!-- Snow on branches -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#e8f4fd'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#e8f4fd'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='57' r='1.5' fill='#e8f4fd'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#e8f4fd'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#e8f4fd'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#e8f4fd'/>
  
  <!-- Star glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='1.5' fill='#fff8b0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
